data.name: 1,3-Bis(trifluoromethyl)benzene with Water
measurement_methods: The absorbances of the extracted samples were measured (265 nm) with a Pye Unicam SP 30 spectrophotometer.
mixing_methods: An excess of 1,3-bis(trifluoromethy1) benzene was stirred with 100 ml water in a closed flask in a thermally regulated bath (±0.1°C) for 30 min.
After phase separation and standing for several hours, two samples of known amounts were removed from the aqueous phase and extracted with hexane.

publication_references.citation: Strachan, A.N.; Field, J.P.; Fleming, K.A., Int. Solvent Extr. Conf., (Proc.), Vol. 2, 1980, page paper 80-2, 6 pp.
